metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the dependency-free Rust Cargo project in [output/](/workspace/output), with the CLI entry point at [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It parses `.bib` and citation inputs, executes `.bst` styles, writes `.bbl` output, and produces the requested JSON log or error file.

`cargo build --release` succeeds. All five unit tests pass, and I exercised `plain`, `alpha`, `unsrt`, and `abbrv` against a sample database. A reference BibTeX binary was unavailable, so byte-for-byte parity against the historic executable remains unverified.

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/bibtex-build0/build/release/bibtex_compat',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_crossref_parent_inclusion0')
children = 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("children", [1, 2])
    def test_crossref_parent_inclusion_threshold(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path, children: int
    ) -> None:
        # btxdoc lines 163–175 and bibtex.web min_crossrefs=2: an uncited
        # parent is included only after two cited children refer to it. For a
        # single child, inheritance survives but its crossref pointer is removed.
        # Canonical parity corpora use explicit fields so this one rule cannot
        # mask eight independent style executions.
        bib = "".join(f'@misc{{c{i}, crossref = "p"}}\n' for i in range(children))
        bib += '@misc{p, year = "2020"}\n'
        style = r"""
    ENTRY { year } { } { }
    FUNCTION {emit}
    { cite$ write$ ":" write$
      crossref missing$ { "none" } { crossref } if$ write$
      ":" write$ year write$ newline$
    }
    READ
    ITERATE {emit}
    """
        bbl, _ = run_bibtex(
            submission_command, bib, style, [f"c{i}" for i in range(children)], tmp_path
        )
        expected = ["c0:none:2020"] if children == 1 else ["c0:p:2020", "c1:p:2020", "p:none:2020"]
>       assert bbl.splitlines() == expected
E       AssertionError: assert ['c0:p:2020'] == ['c0:none:2020']
E         
E         At index 0 diff: 'c0:p:2020' != 'c0:none:2020'
E         Use -v to get more diff
